summary: Verified 'Amortizar Capital' and 'Incorporar Juros' actions in the ⋮ menu of the Emprestimos list (/emprestimos). Menu items appear correctly for the Demo Amortizacao (sem_prazo, ativo) loan; the duplicated 'Registrar Pagamento' item has been removed. Modals on the list open, compute Novo capital in real-time, and successfully persist changes (capital went 1600 → 1400 via Amortizar 200, then 1400 → 1450 via Incorporar 50). Backend integration works and the list refreshes with the new capital in both cases.

ui_bugs.component: Emprestimos.js Amortizar/Incorporar list modals - Confirm buttons
ui_bugs.issue: The Confirm buttons use the custom '../components/Button' which accepts a 'testId' prop (renders data-testid={testId}) and does NOT forward arbitrary props. As a result data-testid="confirmar-amortizacao-btn-lista" and data-testid="confirmar-incorporacao-btn-lista" are silently dropped and are absent from the rendered DOM. Cancelar buttons (also using custom Button) similarly ignore any data-testid. Functional behavior is fine but automated tests cannot target these buttons by the requested data-testid.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Emprestimos.js, change the two confirm Button usages from data-testid="confirmar-amortizacao-btn-lista" (line ~1040) and data-testid="confirmar-incorporacao-btn-lista" (line ~1115) to testId="..." — OR update /app/frontend/src/components/Button.js to accept a data-testid prop (e.g., `data-testid={testId || props['data-testid']}`) so the standard attribute is honored. Same fix would help future test coverage for all custom Buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: Custom Button component (/app/frontend/src/components/Button.js) only supports a proprietary testId prop and does NOT spread extra props, silently dropping data-testid, aria-*, id, etc. Consider spreading {...rest} or at least accepting data-testid to align with the rest of the codebase.
Emprestimos.js is ~1128 lines; consider splitting the two 'ações da lista' modals (amortizar/incorporar) into their own components for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing Demo Amortizacao loan; capital changed from R$1.600 to R$1.450 as part of testing per instructions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Menu items (menu-amortizar, menu-incorporar) and modal wrappers/inputs/labels (amortizar-modal-lista, amortizar-valor-input-lista, amortizar-novo-capital-lista, incorporar-modal-lista, incorporar-valor-input-lista, incorporar-novo-capital-lista, incorporar-juros-aberto-lista) all render correctly. The confirm buttons currently do NOT have data-testid in the DOM due to the custom Button component ignoring data-testid; use get_by_role('button', name='Confirmar amortização'/'Confirmar incorporação') as a workaround until the fix is applied. Success modal 'Amortização/Incorporação Registrada!' appears after confirming and requires clicking OK before doing further actions on the row.
rca of the issue: Root cause of missing data-testid on confirm buttons: the custom Button component at /app/frontend/src/components/Button.js destructures a fixed set of props ({children, type, variant, disabled, className, onClick, testId, preventDoubleClick, doubleClickDelay, loading}) and does not spread the remaining props onto the underlying <button>. It also only wires data-testid={testId}. Since Emprestimos.js passes `data-testid="..."` (not `testId="..."`), the attribute is discarded during render. Fix by either (a) renaming the props in Emprestimos.js to `testId`, or (b) updating Button.js to accept `data-testid` (or spread rest props).
